chunks: And in it, that the Imam (peace be upon him) said: It is not permissible for a man to pray alone except in case of necessity.
ai.seo_question: When is it permissible for a man to pray alone?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq contextualizes this ruling within the broader Shia jurisprudence that elevates congregational prayer (salat al-jama'ah) as the sunnah of the Prophet and Imams, while permitting solitary prayer only under valid excuses (‘udhr) such as illness or travel. This distinction underscores the communal aspect of worship in Shia tradition, where the presence of a congregation signifies spiritual unity and social cohesion, making solitary prayer a temporary deviation rather than the norm.
